publication: The game editor's first release and modeling 0.5.65, from one revision: twelve new versions (blender-engine 0.1.7 is unchanged). Every registry shasum and integrity matches the exact tested archive, and every tarball downloaded with no credentials or environment is byte-identical to it.

checks.packedImports: 1120 files across 8 packages (modeling); 2179 files across 13 packages (game)
checks.servedModules: served-bundle table matches the template and catalog (16 packages); runtime image carries every template and catalog dependency (33)
checks.build: game release build 49 s, 3.25 GB peak

packedAcceptance.game: Runtime image installed from the thirteen archives with no workspace links (582 packages); create linked it and installed nothing; the game opened on the published pinned workbench, played, and an Inspector edit wrote src/scenes/MainScene.tsx with undo/redo round-tripping; tsc and vite build passed from the image.
packedAcceptance.modeling: The eight archives installed with no links (434 packages); the model opened, a Python edit moved Cube to X=3.0, editor undo/redo round-tripped it, and after close a cold stdio MCP read returned X=3.0.
defectsFound: game-live imported @volter/editor-sdk (TypeScript source) externally, which Node refuses under node_modules; it now bundles the SDK client and declares undici.
A bare create made the empty preset (no world, no Play); the default is now game.
A new game showed .vgai/workbench.json and .vgai/recordings/ as changes.

installation.path: npx -y @volter/game-editor@0.5.65 create fresh-game with an empty npm cache: create installed the runtime image from the registry (582 packages, 17 s) and linked it; the game rendered after Vite's first optimization, played, and an edit plus undo/redo round-tripped in source. A second create of that version installed nothing.
installation.workbench: Reused from ~/.vgai/workbenches; the same release was downloaded anonymously earlier on 2026-09-24 and matched its pinned SHA-256.
installation.credentials: Not credential-free: the shell held npm credentials. Public availability is shown separately by the credential-free tarball downloads.
diagnostics: The eight previously existing package names were served about ten minutes after npm reported their publishes; the five new names were served at once.
installation.modelingPath: npx -y @volter/editor@0.5.65 create fresh-models with its own empty npm cache: 434 packages, 0 vulnerabilities; a Python edit set Cube X=4.25, editor undo/redo round-tripped it, and a cold stdio MCP read after close returned 4.25.

audit.scope: The game runtime image: 5 low, 3 moderate, 0 high, all through colyseus -> @colyseus/auth -> grant (elliptic, uuid); no upstream fix.

limitations: See WORK.md for the game editor's remaining list.
